stage_note: Master plan section 6 requires model validation BEFORE W4. This is not W4 itself: the offline constructions additionally require D08 and the D06 freeze.

A2_upper_bound_existence.threshold: certified bound present on >= 99% of covered transitions

A4_lane_change_containment.threshold: reported; leakage into a covered prediction is a soundness failure

gate_rule.UNDER_APPROXIMATING: A1 and A2 hold and coverage >= 0.90
gate_rule.declared_consequence: OVER_APPROXIMATING or PREDICTION_ONLY means no joint opportunity can ever be SUPPORTED under Rule A from such a model.

diagnostic_set.limit: Historical traces can reveal limitations but cannot certify a changed model or domain.

commands.tests: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
